Name: Ed from Animal Crossing Horse
Author: fizzyizze
Description:
This is an edit of the base horse sprite that changes it to look like the smug Animal Crossing villager, Ed. [http://animalcrossing.wikia.com/wiki/Ed]

He's one of my favorites and I thought the normal horse sprite was kinda boring, so I fixed it! This was mostly for personal use but I figured it'd be worth uploading in case anyone else wanted it. Even if you're not into ACNL or the other AC games, it's still just a more fun color scheme and markings for the horse imo. 

Made in GraphicsGale! :) check it out if you haven't, it's free! Have a great day!!

To use: Replace the horse.xml file in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals with this horse.xml file.
If you aren't using Steam, just replace the horse.xml in Animals with this horse.xml file, but without having to navigate thru a ton of annoying Steam folders.

If you might want to revert it, make sure to save a copy of the default horse.xml somewhere before replacing it!
